title: 第0015章 雪莲初现 冰肌玉骨第0016章 仙鹤草显威废柴初露锋芒
content_zh:
黎明前的黑暗，总是格外深沉。
冰冷的雨水敲打着废弃药田的残垣断壁，发出单调而急促的声响，掩盖了空气中尚未散尽的血腥味。
林药尘背靠着那块冰冷的青苔石壁，整个人像是从水里捞出来的一样。汗水、雨水、血水混杂在一起，顺着他棱角分明的下巴滴落，在身下积成一小滩浑浊的水洼。
他大口喘息着，每一次呼吸都牵扯着全身的伤口，带来钻心的剧痛。特别是小腹处，那是被林啸天最后临死反扑踢中的位置，此刻正隐隐泛起一股诡异的寒意，与他体内残存的仙茅热性相互冲突，搅得他五脏六腑如同颠倒了一般。
“这就是越级挑战的代价吗……”
林药尘苦笑一声，想要抬手擦去眼角的血污，却发现手臂沉重得像是灌了铅。
刚才那场搏杀，看似是他赢了，但实际上赢得极其侥幸，或者说，赢得极其惨烈。如果不是关键时刻仙茅药力爆发，再加上白鲜皮解析了毒素，仙鹤草吊住了一口气，他此刻早就已经是一具尸体了。
【叮！检测到宿主身体负荷过重，多处经脉二次撕裂。】
【建议立即进行深度疗养，否则将留下永久性暗伤。】
系统冰冷的提示音在脑海中响起，却让林药尘感到一丝安心。至少，系统还在。
他强忍着剧痛，意识沉入体内，查看目前的状况。
丹田处，原本沉寂的仙茅虚影此刻黯淡了许多，那股刚猛暴烈的药力几乎消耗殆尽。但与之相对的，在仙茅原本的位置旁边，另一株植物的虚影似乎微微颤动了一下。
那是一株通体洁白、花瓣晶莹剔透的兰花状植物——天山雪莲。
如果说仙茅是烈火，那这株雪莲便是寒冰。
刚才林啸天踢出的那一脚中，除了纯粹的武力，竟然还夹杂着一丝阴寒的内劲。这股内劲此刻正盘踞在林药尘的小腹丹田，阻碍着他气血的运行。
“原来如此……林啸天那家伙，竟然也修习了寒属性功法？”
林药尘心中明了。看来这青炎林家的水，比他想象的要深。一个小小的家族少主，竟然身怀两种截然相反的内劲，难怪如此嚣张。
但这股寒劲对他来说，未必是坏事。
【检测到宿主体内存在异种寒性能量，符合天山雪莲炼化条件。】
【是否开启天山雪莲初级形态——冰肌塑体？】

“开启！”
林药尘毫不犹豫地在心中下令。
嗡！
刹那间，一股清凉纯净的气息从丹田深处升起，迅速扩散至四肢百骸。
不同于仙茅的滚烫灼热，这股气息如同寒冬腊月里的第一场雪，清冷、透彻，带着一种洗涤一切尘埃的纯净感。
那股盘踞在小腹的寒劲，仿佛遇到了克星，瞬间被这股清凉气息包裹、消融，最终化为一股精纯的能量，融入林药尘的血脉之中。
随着寒劲被化解，林药尘感觉浑身一轻，原本那种撕裂般的剧痛竟然减轻了不少。更神奇的是，他能清晰地感觉到，在那清凉气息的滋养下，那些受损的肌肉纤维和毛细血管正在以肉眼可见的速度自我修复。
“这就是天山雪莲的效果？冰肌塑体，净化杂质……”
林药尘低头看向自己的手臂。原本青紫交加的皮肤下，竟然隐约透出一层淡淡的玉质光泽，虽然很微弱，但却真实存在。
这就是仙侠传说中的“冰肌玉骨”吗？虽然只是雏形，但已经让他脱胎换骨。
然而，就在他沉浸在身体变强的喜悦中时，一阵急促的脚步声由远及近，打破了雨中的宁静。
不是一个人。
是一群人。
而且来势汹汹，带着明显的敌意。
林药尘瞳孔一缩，强撑着身体站了起来，目光锐利地望向声音传来的方向。
“在那边！血腥味是从那边传来的！”
“快！别让那小子跑了！”
“少主失踪了一晚上，肯定是被这贼子害了！”
七八道身影穿过雨幕，手持火把，很快便出现在林药尘的视线中。
领头的是一名中年男子，面容威严，身穿林家管事服饰，修为赫然达到了聚气境。在他身后，跟着一群林家护卫，个个面色不善，杀气腾腾。

林药尘心中一沉。
content_en:
The darkness before dawn is always particularly deep.
The cold rain beat against the ruins of the abandoned medicine field, making a monotonous and rapid sound, covering up the smell of blood that had not yet dissipated in the air.
Lin Yaochen leaned against the cold mossy stone wall, as if he had been fished out of the water. Sweat, rain, and blood mixed together, dripping down his angular chin, and accumulated into a small pool of turbid puddles underneath him.
He gasped for breath, and every breath pulled at the wounds all over his body, causing excruciating pain. Especially in the lower abdomen, where Lin Xiaotian's final counterattack kicked him, a strange chill was rising, which conflicted with the remaining curculigo heat in his body, making his internal organs seem to be upside down.
"Is this the price of a higher-level challenge..."
Lin Yaochen gave a bitter smile and wanted to raise his hand to wipe the blood from the corner of his eyes, but found that his arm was as heavy as lead.
In the fight just now, it seemed that he won, but in fact, the victory was extremely lucky, or in other words, the victory was extremely tragic. If it weren't for the explosive power of Curculigo at the critical moment, and the analysis of the toxin by the white fresh skin, Agrimony breathed a sigh of relief, he would have been a corpse at this moment.
【bite! It was detected that the host's body was overloaded and multiple meridians were torn for the second time. 】
[It is recommended to undergo deep recuperation immediately, otherwise permanent hidden injuries will be left. 】
The system's cold notification sounded in his mind, but it made Lin Yaochen feel a little relieved. At least, the system is still there.
He endured the severe pain, and his consciousness sank into his body, checking the current situation.
At the dantian, the originally silent Curculigo phantom was now much dimmer, and the fierce and violent medicinal power was almost exhausted. But in contrast, next to the original position of Curculigo, the shadow of another plant seemed to tremble slightly.
It was an orchid-like plant with pure white body and crystal clear petals - Tianshan Snow Lotus.
If curculigo is fire, then this snow lotus is ice.
In addition to pure force, the kick Lin Xiaotian kicked just now was also mixed with a hint of cold inner energy. This inner energy was currently entrenched in Lin Yaochen's lower abdominal dantian, hindering the flow of his qi and blood.
"I see... That guy Lin Xiaotian actually also practices cold-attribute techniques?"
Lin Yaochen understood. It seemed that the water in the Qingyan Lin family was deeper than he thought. A young leader of a small family actually possesses two completely opposite inner strengths. No wonder he is so arrogant.
But this chill may not be a bad thing for him.
[The presence of heterogeneous cold energy in the host has been detected, which meets the conditions for refining Tianshan Snow Lotus. 】
[Do you want to activate the primary form of Tianshan Snow Lotus - Ice Muscle Body Shaping? 】
"Turn on!"
Lin Yaochen ordered in his heart without hesitation.
Buzz!
In an instant, a cool and pure breath rose from the depths of his dantian and quickly spread to his limbs and bones.
Different from the scalding heat of curculigo, this scent is like the first snow in the cold winter, cold and penetrating, with a sense of purity that washes away all dust.
The coldness lingering in the lower abdomen seemed to have met a nemesis. It was instantly enveloped and melted by the cool breath, and finally turned into a pure energy that merged into Lin Yaochen's bloodline.
As the coldness was resolved, Lin Yaochen felt light all over, and the original tearing pain was relieved a lot. What's even more amazing is that he can clearly feel that, nourished by the cool breath, the damaged muscle fibers and capillaries are repairing themselves at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Is this the effect of Tianshan Snow Lotus? It ices the body, sculpts the body, and purifies impurities..."
Lin Yaochen lowered his head and looked at his arm. Under the originally bruised and purple skin, there was a faint jade-like luster. Although it was very faint, it was real.
Is this the "ice muscle and jade bone" in the fairy tale? Although it is only a prototype, it has already transformed him.
However,Just as he was immersed in the joy of becoming stronger, a rush of footsteps approached from far away, breaking the tranquility in the rain.
Not alone.
It's a group of people.
And it came menacingly, with obvious hostility.
Lin Yaochen's pupils shrank, he forced himself to stand up, and looked sharply towards the direction of the sound.
"Over there! The smell of blood is coming from over there!"
"Quick! Don't let that kid get away!"
"The young master has been missing all night. He must have been killed by this thief!"
Seven or eight figures walked through the rain curtain, holding torches, and soon appeared in Lin Yaochen's sight.
The leader was a middle-aged man with a majestic face, wearing the clothes of a steward of the Lin family, and his cultivation had reached the Qi Gathering realm. Behind him, followed a group of Lin family guards, all of whom looked evil and murderous.
Lin Yaochen's heart sank.
